title: Join with Group By
description: Aggregating data across multiple tables.
code:

title: Common Table Expression (CTE)
description: Creating temporary result sets for complex queries.
explanation_md: CTEs improve readability by breaking down complex queries into logical blocks.

title: Common Table Expression (CTE) (Quick Start)
description: Creating temporary result sets for complex queries. Focus: the smallest useful version.
code:
-- Quick Start focus: the smallest useful version
WITH MonthlySales AS (
    SELECT month, SUM(amount) as total
    FROM sales
    GROUP BY month
)
SELECT * FROM MonthlySales WHERE total > 10000;
